ks.title: The Kit Studio
ks.reset.done: Back to a blank shirt. Undo brings your design back.
ks.garment.blank: A blank shirt. Pick a body colour to begin.
ks.tool.body.hint: The main colour of the shirt. Only colours that are right for this club are offered.
ks.tool.trim.hint: A second colour for the pattern, collar and sleeves.
ks.tool.design.hint: The cut of the pattern, drawn in your two colours.
ks.tool.collar.hint: The neckline, and which colour it takes.
ks.tool.maker.hint: Makers from this club's documented kits. The name is lettered; the brand's artwork is never redrawn.
ks.tool.sponsor.hint: Sponsors from this club's documented kits, lettered across the chest.
ks.tool.crest.hint: The club's initials stand in the crest slot. The real crest artwork is not redrawn here.
ks.tool.back.hint: A name and a number for the back of your shirt.
ks.needTrim: No second colour is available for a pattern on this club's palette.
ks.back.name: Name
ks.coll.title: The collection
ks.coll.lockedNote: A shirt opens when you assemble it in Build the Kit. Until then you see its season and an outline, nothing more.
ks.coll.openNote: Every documented shirt is open here. Each card shows exactly what the club's archive records, with its sources.
ks.coll.empty: No shirts are documented for this club yet.
ks.coll.build: Build a shirt to open it
ks.card.locked: {season} {variant} shirt, not yet assembled. Open its card.
ks.card.undrawn: The archive documents this shirt, but in a way that cannot be drawn faithfully here, so it is shown as facts only.
ks.card.recon: Drawn from the documented colours, design, maker and sponsor — a reconstruction, not a photograph. Details the archive does not state are left plain.
ks.card.designFrom: Start a fan design from this shirt
ks.card.lockedArt: An outline: this shirt has not been assembled yet
ks.card.lockedBody: This shirt is still on the hanger. Assemble it in Build the Kit and its card opens with everything the archive records.
ks.save.title: Save your design
ks.save.name: Name
ks.save.fine: Saved on this device only. Up to {max} designs. It stays a fan design — it is never shown as a club kit.
ks.save.fail: This browser would not let us save. Your design is still on screen.
ks.start.done: Started from the {season} shirt. Make it yours.
ks.designs.title: My designs
ks.designs.empty: Nothing saved yet. Design a shirt and press Save.
ks.startFrom.title: Start from a club shirt
ks.startFrom.body: Pick a shirt you have opened. It becomes the first step of a fan design, and your changes never touch the archive.
ks.brief.title: Design briefs
ks.brief.body: Prompts to design to — no score, no winner.
ks.brief.two-tone.title: Two colours, one pattern
ks.brief.two-tone.body: A body colour, a trim colour and any pattern but plain.
ks.brief.classic.title: A classic
ks.brief.classic.body: Plain cloth, one colour, a collar with a shape and no sponsor.
ks.brief.squad.title: Squad number
ks.brief.squad.body: Put a name and a number on the back.
ks.brief.badge-only.title: Badge only
ks.brief.badge-only.body: The crest on the chest and nothing else across it.
ks.help.title: How the studio works
ks.help.studio: Choose a part, then tap a colour, design or name — the shirt changes at once. Undo and redo go back as far as you like.
ks.help.fan: Everything you make here is a fan design. It is saved on this device and never presented as a historical kit.
ks.help.collection: The collection holds the club's documented shirts. Shirts you assemble in Build the Kit open their cards.
ks.help.keys: Keyboard: Ctrl or Cmd + Z to undo, Ctrl or Cmd + Shift + Z (or Y) to redo.
